description.en: Talk about counties, elections, schools, jobs, the environment and technology, and follow a Kenyan news report.
description.so: Ka hadal kaunti-yada, doorashooyinka, dugsiyada, shaqada, deegaanka iyo tiknoolajiyada, oo raac warbixin wareed oo Kenya ah.

body.en: Since the 2010 constitution (katiba), Kenya has a national government (serikali ya kitaifa) and forty-seven county governments (serikali za kaunti), each led by a gavana. This sharing of power is called ugatuzi (devolution). Garissa, Mombasa and Nairobi are all counties.
body.so: Tan iyo dastuurkii 2010 (katiba), Kenya waxay leedahay dowlad dhexe (serikali ya kitaifa) iyo afartan iyo toddoba dowladood oo kaunti ah (serikali za kaunti), mid walbana waxaa hoggaamiya gavana (guddoomiye). Awood-qaybsigan waxaa la yiraahdaa ugatuzi. Garissa, Mombasa iyo Nairobi dhammaantood waa kaunti.

examples.sw: Kenya ina kaunti arobaini na saba.
examples.so: Kenya waxay leedahay afartan iyo toddoba kaunti.

body.en: Radio and TV news use formal Swahili. Reports usually name their source with kwa mujibu wa (according to) and link ideas with aidha (also, furthermore), hata hivyo (however) and kutokana na (because of, as a result of). You will rarely hear Sheng on the news.
body.so: Wararka raadiyaha iyo TV-ga waxay isticmaalaan Sawaaxili rasmi ah. Warbixinnadu badanaa ilaha waxay ku sheegaan kwa mujibu wa (sida uu sheegay), fikradahana waxay ku xiraan aidha (sidoo kale), hata hivyo (si kastaba ha ahaatee) iyo kutokana na (sababtoo ah). Wararka Sheng dhif ayaad ku maqlaysaa.

examples.sw: Kwa mujibu wa ripoti hiyo, bei ya unga imepanda.
examples.en: According to that report, the price of flour has gone up.
examples.so: Sida ay warbixintaasi sheegtay, qiimaha burku wuu kordhay.

examples.en: However, the rain has started to fall.
examples.so: Si kastaba ha ahaatee, roobkii wuu bilaabmay.

title.so: Magacyada macnaha guud ee ku bilowda u-

body.en: Many abstract nouns start with u-: uchumi (economy), uchaguzi (election), ukosefu (lack), ubunifu (innovation). They come from verbs: chagua (choose) gives uchaguzi, kosa (miss, lack) gives ukosefu, buni (invent) gives ubunifu. Knowing the verb helps you guess the noun.
body.so: Magacyo badan oo macno guud leh waxay ku bilowdaan u-: uchumi (dhaqaale), uchaguzi (doorasho), ukosefu (la'aan), ubunifu (hal-abuur). Waxay ka yimaadaan falal: chagua (dooro) waxaa ka dhashay uchaguzi, kosa (waa) waxaa ka dhashay ukosefu, buni (ikhtiraac) waxaa ka dhashay ubunifu. Haddii aad falka taqaanno, magaca waad qiyaasi kartaa.

examples.en: The people will choose a new governor.
examples.so: Shacabku waxay dooran doonaan guddoomiye cusub.

body.en: In August 2017 Kenya banned plastic carrier bags, one of the strictest bans in the world. Shoppers now carry cloth or woven bags. Tree planting is a national habit too: schools, churches, mosques and companies hold tree-planting days, especially in the rainy seasons.
body.so: Bishii Ogosto 2017 Kenya waxay mamnuucday bacaha caagga ah, oo ka mid ah mamnuucidda ugu adag adduunka. Dukaamaystayaashu hadda waxay sitaan bacaha maradka ama kuwa la tolay. Geed beeriddu sidoo kale waa caado qaran: dugsiyada, kaniisadaha, masaajidda iyo shirkadaha waxay qabtaan maalmo geed beerid, gaar ahaan xilliga roobka.

examples.sw: Tupande miti kwa ajili ya watoto wetu.
examples.en: Let's plant trees for our children's sake.
examples.so: Aan geedo u beerno carruurteenna darteed.

note.en: Kenya has forty-seven counties. In Tanzania the main regions are called mikoa.
note.so: Kenya waxay leedahay afartan iyo toddoba kaunti. Tanzania gobollada waaweyn waxaa la yiraahdaa mikoa.

note.en: On the news you also hear wananchi (the people, ordinary citizens).
note.so: Wararka waxaad sidoo kale ka maqlaysaa wananchi (shacabka, dadweynaha).

note.en: Kura is a vote. Kituo cha kupigia kura is a polling station.
note.so: Kura waa cod. Kituo cha kupigia kura waa goobta codbixinta.

note.en: Chuo alone means a college. Kenyans often just say campus.
note.so: Chuo kaliya waa kulliyad. Kenyaanku badanaa waxay yiraahdaan campus.

note.en: Kenyans say the letters in English: si-bi-si. The new curriculum replaced the old 8-4-4 system; officially it is now often called CBE.
note.so: Kenyaanku xarfaha waxay ku dhawaaqaan Ingiriisi: si-bi-si. Manhajkan cusub wuxuu beddelay nidaamkii hore ee 8-4-4; hadda si rasmi ah badanaa waxaa loo yaqaan CBE.

note.en: A rubbish dump is jalala or dampo. Takataka also means rubbish.
note.so: Meesha qashinka lagu shubo waa jalala ama dampo. Takataka sidoo kale waa qashin.

note.en: Many Kenyans call plastic bags karatasi (lit. papers) or juala.
note.so: Kenyaan badan bacaha caagga waxay ugu yeeraan karatasi (macno ahaan: waraaqo) ama juala.

note.en: Kwenye mtandao = online. Mtandao also means a phone network.
note.so: Kwenye mtandao = internet-ka dushiisa. Mtandao sidoo kale waa shabakadda taleefanka.

note.en: Lit. a clever phone. In daily speech many people just say smartphone.
note.so: Macno ahaan: taleefan caqli badan. Hadalka maalinlaha dad badan waxay yiraahdaan smartphone.

lines.sw: Mnamo mwezi wa Agosti, mwaka elfu mbili na kumi na saba, Kenya ilipiga marufuku mifuko ya plastiki ya kubebea bidhaa.
lines.en: In August 2017, Kenya banned plastic carrier bags.
lines.so: Bishii Ogosto ee sannadkii 2017, Kenya waxay mamnuucday bacaha caagga ah ee alaabta lagu qaado.

lines.sw: Kabla ya hapo, mifuko hiyo ilionekana kila mahali: mitaroni, mitoni na hata juu ya miti.
lines.en: Before that, the bags were seen everywhere: in ditches, in rivers and even up in trees.
lines.so: Intaa ka hor, bacahaasi meel walba ayay ka muuqdeen: bohollada biyaha, webiyada iyo xataa geedaha dushooda.

lines.sw: Mifugo mingi ilikula taka za plastiki na kuugua.
lines.en: Many livestock ate plastic waste and fell sick.
lines.so: Xoolo badan ayaa cunay qashinka caagga ah oo bukooday.

lines.sw: Chini ya sheria mpya, mtu anayetengeneza, kuuza au kutumia mifuko hiyo anaweza kutozwa faini kubwa.
lines.en: Under the new law, anyone who makes, sells or uses those bags can be given a heavy fine.
lines.so: Sharciga cusub hoostiisa, qof kasta oo samaysta, iibiya ama isticmaala bacahaas waxaa lagu ganaaxi karaa ganaax culus.

lines.sw: Mwanzoni, wafanyabiashara wengi walilalamika kwamba hawana njia nyingine.
lines.en: At first, many traders complained that they had no alternative.
lines.so: Bilowgii, ganacsato badan ayaa ka cabanayay inaanay lahayn waddo kale.

lines.sw: Hata hivyo, baada ya muda mfupi, wanunuzi walianza kubeba mifuko ya kitambaa na vikapu.
lines.en: However, after a short time, shoppers began carrying cloth bags and baskets.
lines.so: Si kastaba ha ahaatee, muddo yar kadib, dukaamaystayaashu waxay bilaabeen inay sitaan bacaha maradka ah iyo dambiilo.

lines.sw: Mama mboga mmoja wa Kisumu alisema kuwa wateja wake sasa huja na vikapu vyao wenyewe.
lines.en: One vegetable seller in Kisumu said her customers now come with their own baskets.
lines.so: Iibiyaha khudaarta oo ka mid ah Kisumu ayaa sheegay in macaamiisheedu hadda la yimaadaan dambiilahooda.

lines.sw: Wataalamu wanasema mazingira ya miji mingi yamekuwa safi zaidi.
lines.en: Experts say the environment in many towns has become cleaner.
lines.so: Khubarada ayaa sheegaya in deegaanka magaalooyin badan uu ka nadiifsan yahay sidii hore.

lines.sw: Lakini changamoto bado zipo, kwa sababu chupa za plastiki bado zinatupwa ovyo.
lines.en: But challenges remain, because plastic bottles are still thrown away carelessly.
lines.so: Laakiin caqabado weli way jiraan, sababtoo ah dhalooyinka caagga ah weli si kasta ayaa loo tuuraa.

lines.sw: Ili kupambana na mabadiliko ya tabianchi, shule nyingi sasa zinawafundisha wanafunzi kupanda miti.
lines.en: To fight climate change, many schools now teach pupils to plant trees.
lines.so: Si loola dagaallamo isbeddelka cimilada, dugsiyo badan hadda waxay ardayda baraan geed beerid.

lines.sw: Mwaka elfu mbili na saba, huduma ya M-Pesa ilizinduliwa nchini Kenya.
lines.en: In 2007, the M-Pesa service was launched in Kenya.
lines.so: Sannadkii 2007, adeegga M-Pesa waxaa laga daah-furay Kenya.

lines.sw: Wakati huo, Wakenya wengi hawakuwa na akaunti za benki.
lines.en: At that time, many Kenyans had no bank accounts.
lines.so: Waqtigaas, Kenyaan badan ma lahayn xisaab bangi.

lines.sw: Kwa kutumia simu ya kawaida tu, mtu aliweza kutuma pesa kwa jamaa zake kijijini.
lines.en: Using just an ordinary phone, a person could send money to relatives in the village.
lines.so: Isagoo isticmaalaya taleefan caadi ah oo keliya, qofku wuxuu lacag u diri karay qaraabadiisa tuulada joogta.

lines.sw: Huduma hii haikuhitaji mtandao wala simu janja.
lines.en: The service needed neither the internet nor a smartphone.
lines.so: Adeeggani uma baahnayn internet iyo taleefan casri ah midna.

lines.sw: Leo, mamilioni ya Wakenya hulipa nauli, kodi na karo za shule kwa M-Pesa.
lines.en: Today, millions of Kenyans pay fares, rent and school fees with M-Pesa.
lines.so: Maanta, malaayiin Kenyaan ah waxay M-Pesa ku bixiyaan lacagta gaadiidka, kirada iyo khidmadda dugsiga.

lines.sw: Wataalamu wa teknolojia duniani wanaitaja M-Pesa kama mfano mzuri wa ubunifu wa Kiafrika.
lines.en: Technology experts around the world cite M-Pesa as a fine example of African innovation.
lines.so: Khubarada tiknoolajiyadda adduunka waxay M-Pesa u soo qaataan tusaale wanaagsan oo hal-abuur Afrikaan ah.

lines.sw: Nchi nyingine kadhaa zimeiga mfumo huo.
lines.en: Several other countries have copied the system.
lines.so: Dhowr dal oo kale ayaa nidaamkaas ku daydey.

lines.sw: Hata hivyo, matapeli nao wametumia teknolojia hii kuwadanganya watu.
lines.en: However, scammers too have used this technology to deceive people.
lines.so: Si kastaba ha ahaatee, khiyaanoolayaashu iyaguna tiknoolajiyaddan waxay u adeegsadeen inay dadka ku khiyaaneeyaan.

lines.sw: Kwa hivyo, kila mtumiaji anashauriwa asimpe mtu yeyote namba yake ya siri.
lines.en: So every user is advised not to give anyone their PIN.
lines.so: Sidaa darteed, isticmaale kasta waxaa lagula talinayaa inuusan qofna siin lambarkiisa sirta ah.

lines.so: Kaunti-ga Garissa, xarun cusub oo dhallinyarada ah ayaa la furay si loo baro xirfadaha tiknoolajiyadda.

lines.sw: Afisa mmoja wa kaunti alisema kituo hicho kitasaidia kupunguza ukosefu wa ajira.
lines.en: A county official said the centre will help to reduce unemployment.
lines.so: Sarkaal ka tirsan kaunti-ga ayaa sheegay in xaruntaasi gacan ka geysan doonto yaraynta shaqo la'aanta.

lines.sw: Aidha, wanafunzi wa vyuo vikuu wamerejea masomoni baada ya likizo ndefu.
lines.en: Also, university students have returned to their studies after a long holiday.
lines.so: Sidoo kale, ardayda jaamacadaha ayaa dib ugu laabtay waxbarashadooda kadib fasax dheer.

lines.sw: Katika michezo, mwanariadha chipukizi kutoka Iten ameshinda mbio za kilomita kumi mjini Eldoret.
lines.en: In sport, a promising young athlete from Iten has won a ten-kilometre race in Eldoret.
lines.so: Dhinaca ciyaaraha, orod-yahan dhallinyaro ah oo ka yimid Iten ayaa ku guuleystay tartan toban kiiloomitir ah oo ka dhacay magaalada Eldoret.

lines.sw: Hali ya hewa: mvua inatarajiwa katika maeneo mengi ya magharibi mwa nchi.
lines.en: The weather: rain is expected in many parts of the west of the country.
lines.so: Cimilada: roob ayaa laga filayaa meelo badan oo galbeedka dalka ah.

lines.sw: Kwa habari zaidi, soma gazeti lako kesho asubuhi.
lines.en: For more news, read your newspaper tomorrow morning.
lines.so: Warar dheeraad ah, akhri wargeyskaaga berri subax.

lines.sw: Asanteni kwa kutusikiliza, na usiku mwema.
lines.en: Thank you for listening, and good night.
lines.so: Waad ku mahadsan tihiin dhagaysigiinna, habeen wanaagsan.

question.en: What has happened to the price of maize flour?
question.so: Maxaa ku dhacay qiimaha burka galleyda?

options.en: A youth centre for technology skills
options.so: Xarun dhallinyarada loogu talagalay xirfadaha tiknoolajiyadda

options.en: In the west of the country

options: Ndiyo, kuna ripoti ndefu kuhusu ajira kwa vijana.

explain.en: 'Have you read today's newspaper?' – 'Yes, there's a long report about jobs for young people.'
explain.so: 'Ma akhriday wargeyska maanta?' – 'Haa, waxaa ku jirta warbixin dheer oo ku saabsan shaqooyinka dhallinyarada.'

meaning.en: The journalist wrote a report about the pollution of the Nairobi River.
meaning.so: Weriyuhu wuxuu qoray warbixin ku saabsan wasakheynta webiga Nairobi.

extra.answer: Kwa mujibu wa mwandishi wa habari
